description: The Walrus is a Canadian general interest magazine of long form journalism, essays, fiction and poetry, covering national politics, culture, science and social questions from a Canadian vantage point, with illustrated covers commissioned from artists. It appears eight times a year in print alongside a large online operation, podcasts and a national talks series. It is for readers who want in depth Canadian current affairs and cultural writing.

THIIIRD is a London print magazine of fashion editorials, feature interviews, photo stories and essays centred on people of colour and on queer, trans and non binary creatives. Each themed issue, most recently Dis/comfort, appears with several covers and sits alongside a podcast and events programme. It is for readers interested in fashion, arts and culture framed through intersectional perspectives.

TUNICA is an art and fashion publication from a New York creative studio, each volume built around a theme, the tenth being Total Freedom, and filled with photography, illustration, fashion editorials, essays, fiction and interviews from an international roster of image makers. Volumes are softcover, around 124 pages at 23 by 28 cm, and appear with several front and back covers. It is for readers of visually driven art and fashion publications who follow emerging image making.

Turps is a magazine about painting in which the writers are painters rather than critics. Each issue carries interviews, studio conversations and essays on contemporary and historical painters, with no advertising. It is for practising painters, art students and readers who want painters' own views on painting.

TYPEONE Magazine is an English language print magazine about typography and graphic design, with studio interviews, opinion pieces, industry insight and career advice. Each issue is themed and guest designed, and alternate limited edition covers are common. It is for graphic designers, type designers and students.

Umbigo is a Portuguese contemporary art magazine, published since 2002, that builds each issue around a theme with essays, artist profiles, commissioned art projects and an exhibition section. Since issue 68 it has appeared in separate Portuguese and English editions with two alternative artist covers. It is for readers following contemporary art in Portugal and the Lusophone world.

Unemployed is a large format, image led New York magazine built around commissioned fashion and art photography, with each issue redesigned around a theme. Issues appear roughly once a year in small runs and carry contributors from fashion photography and contemporary art. It is for collectors of photography and fashion publications.

Union is a Tokyo made, English language fashion and photography magazine produced as a cloth bound hardcover of around 184 pages. Each issue gathers long photo stories by international photographers with very little text, built to still look right decades from now. It is for readers of fashion photography and collectors of photo books.

Vanish is a print magazine about the overlap of outdoor life and urban style, covering technical apparel, design, architecture, travel and the people shaping outdoor culture. Issues are themed paperbacks of around 200 pages with brand profiles, interviews and fashion style photography. It is for readers interested in gorpcore fashion, outdoor design and adventure travel.

Vingt Sept is a fashion and culture magazine printed in several cover editions per issue, each fronted by an actor, musician or model and backed by fashion editorials, beauty stories and interviews. Its site adds daily coverage of fashion shows, beauty, restaurants, hotels and arts events in London and New York. It suits readers of glossy independent fashion titles who follow emerging screen and music talent.

Watershed Sentinel is an environmental news magazine from Vancouver Island covering water, forests, energy projects, climate, food systems, Indigenous rights and conservation in British Columbia and western Canada. Each themed issue gathers reporting, analysis and opinion from grassroots campaigners, scientists and community writers. It is for readers who follow regional environmental politics and activism rather than general nature writing.

We Are Makers is a print magazine about craftspeople and artists around the world, built from studio and workshop visits, long interviews and documentary photography. Each edition profiles a dozen or so makers across ceramics, furniture, textiles and metalwork, concentrating on how they live and work rather than on instructions. It is for readers interested in craft, making and small creative businesses.

We Jazz Magazine is a quarterly English language journal about jazz and creative music from Helsinki, each issue built around a focus artist alongside long profiles, a record collecting column, album and live reviews and photo essays. The 128 page print edition is sold with a bonus digital album. It is for listeners of jazz, improvised and experimental music.

Wonderland is a British fashion and pop culture magazine that puts actors, musicians and models on multiple collectable covers each issue, with fashion editorials, celebrity interviews and features on film, music, beauty and art. Issues are sold per cover edition alongside daily online coverage of the same subjects. It is for readers who follow celebrity fashion photography and new screen and music talent.

Wunderdog is a British magazine about rescue dogs and dog welfare, telling the stories of adopted dogs and the people around them. Issues combine long interviews with campaigners and charities, photo essays, travel pieces on dog friendly places and reports on street dogs abroad. It is for dog owners and adopters who want a campaigning, photography led read rather than training or breed advice.

yolk is an English language literary journal from Montreal printing fiction, poetry, non fiction, translations and visual art by Canadian and international writers and artists, with an interview in each issue. Print issues appear twice a year in a small 7 by 9 inch format alongside a rolling online publication and an annual fiction prize. It is for readers and writers of contemporary Canadian literary magazines.

ZOO Magazine is a large format fashion, art and film magazine published in English from Amsterdam, with each issue printed in several cover versions fronted by actors, musicians and models. Issues mix long fashion editorials with interviews, portfolios and features on cinema, music and contemporary art around a theme. It is for readers of international fashion and culture glossies who collect multi cover issues.
